hero.title: Wedding Content Creator: the complete guide to capturing your day differently
hero.subtitle: Stories, reels, aftermovies: a new kind of coverage, complementary to the photographer, made for couples who want to relive — and share — their wedding as soon as the day after.

intro.p1: In 2025, a wedding is no longer told solely through a photo album delivered 3 months later. Couples want to relive their day immediately, share the best moments with loved ones, and keep a short, dynamic video trace that matches their generation.
intro.p2: That's exactly the role of a wedding content creator: a vendor halfway between a photographer, a videographer and a community manager, able to deliver Instagram stories, reels and an aftermovie in just a few days.

sections.heading: Content creator vs photographer: what's the difference?
sections.body: The traditional photographer captures key moments with a strong aesthetic and artistic vision — for a timeless result delivered over several weeks. The content creator focuses on short, vertical, ready-to-post formats: 30-second reels, live stories, 3–5-minute aftermovies. The two services complement each other — they don't compete.
bullets: Fast delivery: stories & reels within 48h, aftermovie within 5 days
More accessible pricing than a traditional videographer
Discreet presence, tuned to the wedding's atmosphere

sections.heading: What a content creator actually captures
sections.body: A good content creator can tell your wedding in 60 seconds as well as in 5 minutes. They alternate wide and tight shots, catch the glances, the laughs, the details — the flowing dress, the clinking glasses, the first dance — and edit it all with an emotional soundtrack.
bullets: Instagram stories shared live with your guests
Aftermovie edited in a few days

items.q: What's the difference vs. a traditional photographer or videographer?
items.a: Our content creator focuses on modern, shareable formats (stories, reels, short aftermovies) in addition to classic photos. Social-ready, fast-delivered, more affordable.

items.q: When do we receive our content?
items.a: Stories and reels within 48h. Aftermovie within 5 days (Complete Pack) or 7 days (Premium Pack). Photos via a private online gallery.

items.q: Can we offer this as a wedding gift?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer personalised gift vouchers — an original, memorable present for the couple-to-be.

items.q: Is the content creator discreet during the ceremony?
items.a: Yes, our content creators are trained to remain fully discreet while capturing the best moments, working in harmony with the photographer and videographer.
